read.cue: two opponents are getting open at the net-front and slot while the puck is in the corner

interaction.prompt: The other team has the puck in your corner and two of their players are getting open near your net. Drag your three players to lock down the most dangerous ice.

feedback.right: That's tight coverage: your D takes the most dangerous man at the net, your centre protects the slot, and your winger pressures the puck. The middle is locked.
feedback.wrong: All three chasing the puck leaves the net-front and slot wide open — that's where goals come from. Take away the dangerous men in the middle first, then pressure the puck.

tip: Cover the most dangerous ice first: net-front and slot. Only one player goes to the puck.
why: The trap is to chase the puck with everyone. The dangerous opponents are the ones open in front of your net, so cover them before you pressure the puck.
